direction: Directly attack rigidity by computing tangent-space flexes and forcing selected contacts to open. At the incumbent, build a $6\times5$ tangent basis for every point, form the contact Jacobian for pairs with slack below $2\times10^{-4}$, and use its SVD or sparse LP dual information to identify overloaded hubs and near-dependent contact sets; then solve modified trust-region LPs in tangent variables with radius $0.01$–$0.05$ in which a chosen set $S$ of $100$–$300$ contacts, concentrated on one hub or one graph cluster, is required to satisfy the linearized bound $\langle x_i,x_j\rangle_{\rm lin}\le t-\delta$ for $\delta\in\{10^{-4},5\times10^{-4},10^{-3}\}$, while all other near contacts satisfy $\le t$. Step along the resulting displacement even if the exact renormalized maximum temporarily worsens, remove the forced-slack constraints, and re-polish with ordinary soft-max/LP; cycle over different hubs, clusters, $\delta$, and trust radii. This systematically deletes contacts and creates a floppy pocket, unlike random shakes, which almost surely increase at least one of the $1{,}300$ equalized constraints.

idea: Break the 1300-contact jam by surgically removing overloaded hubs and re-inserting them into optimal holes plus neighbourhood soft-max re-optimization, screened by short anneals and finally jammed with full annealing and trust-region LP.

Non-monotone cap-and-cluster avalanches that delete hub BFS neighbourhoods or spherical caps, greedily refill from 60k candidates plus hole optimization, re-jam with taboo-boosted soft-max annealing and keep Jaccard-diverse archive for final LP jamming.
direction: Use non-monotone cap-and-cluster avalanches with an explicit contact-graph taboo, rather than accepting only immediate improvements. Repeatedly choose either a high-contact hub and its breadth-first contact neighbourhood or a spherical cap around a random/hub direction, delete $18$–$35$ points, refill greedily from at least $60{,}000$ random candidates plus locally optimized largest-hole candidates, and re-jam with soft-max annealing from $\tau\approx0.02$ down to $0.001$ while allowing intermediate true maxima as high as the incumbent plus $0.005$–$0.015$. During the first re-jam add a penalty, implemented either in the soft-max weights or as an added smooth term, against recreating deleted old contact pairs, and retain a candidate for full LP polishing if its near-contact graph has Jaccard similarity below about $0.7$ to the incumbent even when it is initially worse by up to $2\times10^{-4}$. Run many short cycles, keep a small archive ranked by both score and graph diversity, and reserve the final $25$ seconds for LP-polishing the best archived code; the point is to cross a real topology barrier instead of repeatedly screening perturbations that fall back into the original graph.

direction: Abandon the record as the sole seed and use cardinality homotopy plus algebraic constructions to generate genuinely different basins. Build codes for easier sizes $N'=235$–$248$, optimize them well, then insert points one at a time at adaptively optimized largest holes with a short re-jam after each insertion until reaching $249$; conversely optimize overfull codes with $252$–$260$ points, repeatedly delete the point whose removal most reduces the maximum of the remainder, and re-jam after each deletion. In parallel generate structured seeds from $D_6$ roots, random $6$-dimensional slices/projections of the $240$ $E_8$ roots augmented by hole points, and coordinate-pattern families given by permutations and sign choices of vectors such as $(\pm a,\pm b,\pm c,0,0,0)$ with $a,b,c$ optimized, rotating and randomly perturbing the best examples. Race these constructions with short soft-max polishes, select finalists by score plus contact-graph dissimilarity rather than score alone, and spend the remaining time on full LP equalization of the best finalist.

idea: Tangent-space active-set LP jamming with exact acceptance and rattler-to-hole basin moves.
direction: Replace the final soft-max stage with exact active-set trust-region LP jamming and use any resulting gain or certified rigidity as the local-optimum test. Starting from `best.npy`, build for each point a $6\times5$ orthonormal tangent basis, parameterize displacements by $249\cdot5$ tangent variables plus $t$, linearize every pair with slack below $2\times10^{-3}$ as a constraint on $t$, solve the sparse LP with `scipy.optimize.linprog(method="highs")` inside an adaptively halved trust region, and accept a step only if the exact maximum cosine decreases. Iterate until the active pairs are tied to near machine precision, inspect LP multipliers for nonnegative per-point force balance, identify true rattlers, and only then try targeted moves of rattlers or multiplier-free points; always fall back to the best exact configuration encountered if an LP fails.

Impose reflection/swap and 3-cycle orbit symmetries with 124 pairs+1 fixed point or 83 triples, optimize only representatives with soft-max L-BFGS, then break symmetry with jitter plus full annealing and tangent-LP jamming.
direction: Search symmetry-constrained orbit configurations and then break the symmetry, rather than optimizing 249 unrelated points. For example, impose the $3+3$ reflection symmetry $(u,v)\mapsto(u,-v)$: optimize 124 representative pairs plus one point with $v=0$, giving exactly $2\cdot124+1=249$ points, and repeat with coordinate permutations and other involutions or small cyclic coordinate-permutation groups whose orbit sizes can sum to 249. Optimize only the representatives with a short soft-max schedule, score the expanded configuration exactly, then release all 249 points for brief annealing and Direction-1-style LP polishing; retain this as a genuinely different family even if its symmetric optimum is initially slightly worse, because symmetry breaking may enter a basin unreachable by perturbing the asymmetric incumbent.

idea: From-scratch homotopy over scaled power energies with diverse algebraic and low-discrepancy seeds, Gram-sorted deduplication, then deep power plus soft-max polish of only distinct leaders.
direction: Run a genuinely from-scratch global search using a different energy homotopy, reserving the incumbent only as a fallback. Generate many deterministic low-discrepancy and random starts on $S^5$, plus rotated algebraic seeds built from $D_6$ roots, cross-polytopes, coordinate layers, and greedy extensions, then minimize power energies $\sum_{i<j}(\langle x_i,x_j\rangle_+)^p$ or Riesz-type repulsive energies for increasing $p$ such as $8,16,32,64,128$ rather than immediately using log-sum-exp soft-max. Screen dozens of short L-BFGS runs by exact maximum cosine, discard near-duplicates by pairwise configuration distance after optimal rotation alignment, fully anneal only the best three structurally distinct candidates, and return whichever of those or the loaded incumbent has the lowest exact score.

idea: Escape the hyperstatic jam along the softest second-order nullspace directions with geodesic steps filtered by contact-graph novelty and short LP re-jamming.
direction: Perform a second-order nullspace escape from the certified jam: build the active-contact Jacobian \(A\) for all pairs with slack below \(10^{-7}\), expressed in \(249\times5\) tangent coordinates, remove the 15 infinitesimal rotation modes, and compute the 20 smallest nonzero singular directions using randomized SVD of \(A\) or eigendecomposition of \(A^{T}A\). For each direction and both signs, move geodesically on the sphere with angular step sizes \(0.02,0.05,0.10,\) and \(0.20\) radians, evaluate the exact maximum cosine, and temporarily accept steps worsening it by at most \(2\times10^{-3}\) only when the new contact graph at slack \(10^{-4}\) has Jaccard similarity below \(0.9\) to the incumbent graph. Re-jam each surviving candidate with at most eight short LP iterations, retain only exact improvements over \(0.7034808169015\), cycle through the singular directions until the time budget is nearly exhausted, and always return the best exactly evaluated configuration found.

Exact active-set tangent LP jamming with adaptive trust region plus hub/cap avalanche refills and rattler reinsertion to escape the smeared pseudo-optimum basin.
direction: Replace the final soft-max stage with exact active-set trust-region LP jamming and use any resulting gain or certified rigidity as the local-optimum test. Starting from `best.npy`, build for each point a $6\times5$ orthonormal tangent basis, parameterize displacements by $249\cdot5$ tangent variables plus $t$, linearize every pair with slack below $2\times10^{-3}$ as a constraint on $t$, solve the sparse LP with `scipy.optimize.linprog(method="highs")` inside an adaptively halved trust region, and accept a step only if the exact maximum cosine decreases. Iterate until the active pairs are tied to near machine precision, inspect LP multipliers for nonnegative per-point force balance, identify true rattlers, and only then try targeted moves of rattlers or multiplier-free points; always fall back to the best exact configuration encountered if an LP fails.

idea: Search a distinct Dihedral-12 orbit basin with 20 full orbits plus a 9-point partial orbit then release symmetry with controlled kicks and LP-jamming.
direction: Search for a genuinely different near-symmetric basin using group-orbit constructions: generate configurations invariant under the order-12 group generated by cyclic permutation of the six coordinates and coordinate reversal, using generic orbits of size 12 plus smaller special orbits or a fixed coordinate-frame subset to total exactly 249 unique points. Optimize only the orbit representatives—roughly twenty-one 6-vectors—with analytic softmax or \(p\)-norm L-BFGS at successively sharper temperatures, thereby searching a low-dimensional symmetric family instead of the incumbent’s 1,245-dimensional basin. Then break the symmetry with controlled tangent perturbations of magnitudes \(0.005,0.02,\) and \(0.05\), LP-jam each released configuration, and compare its contact graph and exact score with the incumbent; retain this route even if the symmetric precursor is initially worse, provided its post-release jam reaches a distinct graph, and return the incumbent if no released candidate improves it.

idea: Stress-guided delete-and-refill surgery on LP dual hubs plus rattlers with greedy hole filling and subset softmax optimization.
direction: Use LP dual stresses for targeted large-scale surgery rather than random kicks: run the incumbent LP to obtain nonnegative dual weights for active contacts, compute each point’s total dual stress and contact degree, then select a movable set consisting of the two rattlers, the highest-stress hubs—especially points with at least 15 contacts—and their contact neighbors, totaling 20–35 points. Freeze all other points, delete the movable set, and refill those positions from a pool of at least 100,000 random sphere samples scored against the frozen points, greedily choosing deep holes while maintaining mutual separation and then optimizing only the movable coordinates by softmax L-BFGS against both frozen and movable points. Follow with a short global LP jam; repeat with different stressed neighborhoods and acceptance thresholds, keeping a candidate only if its exact maximum improves, so stress is transferred away from hubs instead of merely perturbing already jammed points.

idea: Cap-and-hub avalanches that delete overloaded neighborhoods or spherical caps, greedily refill holes from large random pools, then re-jam with decreasing soft-max annealing while wandering non-monotonically to a new balanced basin.
Second-order nullspace escape from the jam using projected active-Jacobian eigenvectors with geodesic steps and Jaccard-diverse short LP re-jamming.
direction: Perform a second-order nullspace escape from the certified jam: build the active-contact Jacobian \(A\) for all pairs with slack below \(10^{-7}\), expressed in \(249\times5\) tangent coordinates, remove the 15 infinitesimal rotation modes, and compute the 20 smallest nonzero singular directions using randomized SVD of \(A\) or eigendecomposition of \(A^{T}A\). For each direction and both signs, move geodesically on the sphere with angular step sizes \(0.02,0.05,0.10,\) and \(0.20\) radians, evaluate the exact maximum cosine, and temporarily accept steps worsening it by at most \(2\times10^{-3}\) only when the new contact graph at slack \(10^{-4}\) has Jaccard similarity below \(0.9\) to the incumbent graph. Re-jam each surviving candidate with at most eight short LP iterations, retain only exact improvements over \(0.7034808169015\), cycle through the singular directions until the time budget is nearly exhausted, and always return the best exactly evaluated configuration found.

idea: Hub-neighborhood surgery with fast subset soft-max hops plus Coulomb spreading and sparse tangent-LP jamming to leave the hyperstatic basin toward balanced stress.
